'''Shyn''' was the [[uvak]] owned by [[Sith Saber]] [[Orielle Kitai]], a member of the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. When Kitai was condemned to [[Slavery/Legends|slavery]] following the [[assassination attempt in the Korsinata]], Kitai had to hide the creature in the barn belonging to [[Jelph Marrian]], as slaves were not allowed to own uvak. Shyn was killed when the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Sawj Luzo|Sawj]] and [[Flen Luzo]] came to [[Jelph Marrian's farm]] to confiscate Kitai's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]].
